messages:
Jon (Support): hey @Maya, heads-up — Acme Analytics trial is hitting repeated auth failures and webhook timeouts. customer has 3 seats in trial, renewal window in 5 days. ticket #78912 created :rotating_light:
Maya (CS): ugh. can you drop the most recent error and confirm who we contact at Acme? we'll escalate to CS priority immediately :eyes:
Jon (Support): latest error snippets below
```
AuthError: 401 Unauthorized - token expired (tenant: acme-analytics)
Webhook error: upstream 502 Bad Gateway -> retries exhausted
Trace ID: trace-0a1b2c3d
Last successful delivery: 2024-11-02T14:12:05Z
```
Contact: sara@acme.com (Head of Data). they've attempted onboarding twice, manual SSO step failed previously. ops-bot: linked traces -> https://redwood-logs.internal/acme/78912 and perf dashboard spike -> https://dash.redwood/acme/78912 :link:
Maya (CS): ok triage plan: 1) quick 15m sync today to confirm scope + consent 2) hands-on enablement w/ runbook tomorrow 3) temporary workaround (regen token + manual backfill) before EOD -> escalate to eng if backfill can't complete. who can join enablement? :calendar:
Taylor (Solutions): I can run the enablement and prepare curl + Postman snippets. available 16:00 PT tomorrow. I'll draft a 10m checklist for the invite.
Priya (Onboarding): I'll own the runbook updates and capture permission matrix for token regen. can take notes during the enablement.
Jon (Support): sara can do 3pm PT today for 15m. i'll start token regen on our side after the sync and push creds via vault link.
Maya (CS): great. i'll send the warm intro to Sara + Jon now and create calendar invites for both sessions. tagging owners: @Taylor (Solutions) / @Priya (Onboarding) / @Jon (Support).
Taylor (Solutions): quick rollback idea: if manual backfill fails, revert to polled delivery + rate-limit to avoid downstream spikes. i'll attach that to the invite.
Maya (CS): action items logged. follow-up deliverables: summary note to customer after enablement, renewal health check and risk score update by Friday EOD. if we need eng-runbooks, we'll ping eng-oncall and include the trace links. closing the loop here unless anything else :thumbsup:
